deerbxnes: Yann "Saint" Deerbxnes reported to R-S6 with a cracked shaving mirror sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
At the Chalk Pits, Yann "Saint" Deerbxnes of the Hegemony and Edmund "Hollow" Biwott of the Concord traded insults across the wire for an hour. By the end they were trading recipes.

Yann "Saint" Deerbxnes's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket. A letter from home reached Yann "Saint" Deerbxnes before dusk. Yann "Saint" Deerbxnes read it twice and slept a little easier.
Walter Thehuman taught Yann "Saint" Deerbxnes to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop.

A second spoon disappeared. Yann "Saint" Deerbxnes searched the washing area and found a gap behind the board where everyone left cutlery to dry. A letter from home reached Yann "Saint" Deerbxnes before dusk. Yann "Saint" Deerbxnes read it twice and slept a little easier.
The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Yann "Saint" Deerbxnes did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
edward_a_fuentes: Nobody saw Benedikt "Mole" Fuentes arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in S-S4, and a quiet rifleman under it.

Benedikt "Mole" Fuentes's hands still remember being a tram conductor's hands. Today they mended a broken duckboard as if it were the most important job in the world. A letter from home reached Benedikt "Mole" Fuentes before dusk. Benedikt "Mole" Fuentes read it twice and slept a little easier.

Benedikt "Mole" Fuentes came back from the night raid on two stretcher poles. Nobody is sure which side fired the shot. Benedikt "Mole" Fuentes walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
emir.nothing: Ulrich Nothing stepped off the supply cart at S-S12 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.

Ulrich Nothing (Hegemony) and Konrad Erikvukk (Concord) spotted the same abandoned cart near the Hanging Bridge. A long exchange of shots left the cart exactly where it was. A letter from home found Ulrich Nothing before the night shift. Ulrich Nothing folded it small and kept it close.

Ulrich Nothing checked every ammunition belt by lamplight. One bad cartridge was enough to make him start the whole inspection again. A letter from home found Ulrich Nothing before the night shift. Ulrich Nothing folded it small and kept it close.
Hugo Mrcakerson kept watch so that Ulrich Nothing could sleep. Then Ulrich kept watch so that Hugo could. Neither slept.
Ulrich Nothing walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
i_am_alpharius123: Quentin "Crow" Alpharius reported to S-C6 with a book with the last pages torn out sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
Quentin "Crow" Alpharius walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
richard.deale: Gideon "Mole" Deale came up with a draft of replacements on Day 9. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.

The flare went up just as Gideon "Mole" Deale reached the Hegemony parapet. Gideon "Mole" Deale jumped down first. Benedikt Shi was the man waiting there, and Benedikt Shi fell. (@rei0_shi4) Gideon "Mole" Deale threw a bomb into a Hegemony dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Viktor Kvasnicka was down and screaming for a medic. (@_milan_kvasnicka_) The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into R-R7. Gideon "Mole" Deale has learned to walk bent double. A letter from home reached Gideon "Mole" Deale before dusk. Gideon "Mole" Deale read it twice and slept a little easier.
robertopropane: Pavel Robertopropa introduced himself as a schoolteacher from Millbank. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Pavel Robertopropa watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
solyommadar11: On Day 3, Jonas Solyommadar arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions. Orders came through: Jonas Solyommadar is a sniper now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a rosary of rough beads.

A bullet went through Jonas Solyommadar's sleeve at R-F5 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Konrad "Brick" Romanbhassel of the Hegemony (@romanbhassell). Jonas Solyommadar asked to serve with the Hegemony instead of the Concord. The transfer came through: 4th Platoon, 1st Company, sector R-F3.

Fever took hold of Jonas Solyommadar overnight. The medics changed the dressing twice and then called for the bearers. Mail came up the line with a letter for Jonas Solyommadar. Jonas Solyommadar read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Jonas Solyommadar spent the day on a stretcher outside the aid post, waiting for a bed to come free. The bearers brought water twice. Mail came up the line with a letter for Jonas Solyommadar. Jonas Solyommadar read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Jonas Solyommadar helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

Jonas Solyommadar never saw the inside of the aid post. The medics changed his dressings on the stretcher until the wound closed. He is back on the line. Mail came up the line with a letter for Jonas Solyommadar. Jonas Solyommadar read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Jonas Solyommadar fired at a movement across the wire at R-F3. The man went down: Bram "Hollow" Localfilipin, grazed. Mail came up the line with a letter for Jonas Solyommadar. Jonas Solyommadar read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Jonas Solyommadar rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Otto Johannmigano was grazed at the far edge of no man's land. Mail came up the line with a letter for Jonas Solyommadar. Jonas Solyommadar read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Jonas Solyommadar had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Ivo Joha crossed it, Jonas Solyommadar fired. Ivo Joha was badly wounded. A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Jonas Solyommadar aimed just below it. Henrik Hunted was grazed. Mail came up the line with a letter for Jonas Solyommadar. Jonas Solyommadar read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The stretcher bearers took Jonas Solyommadar in on a busy morning in R-F3. By noon he had learned the first rule of the job, and by evening the second.

Victory at Blackwater Canal. Jonas Solyommadar let himself talk about leave for the first time in days. Mail came up the line with a letter for Jonas Solyommadar. Jonas Solyommadar read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
sonofadeadmeme: Day 6. The corporal put Otto Sonofadeadme beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.
Otto Sonofadeadme tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination.
Asked what he wanted after the war, Otto Sonofadeadme said a chair. After some thought: a chair nobody else was sitting on.
Leopold Moodie of the Concord lost a cap on a night patrol near Saint-Ash crossroads. Otto Sonofadeadme of the Hegemony found it in the morning and now wears it on Sundays.
Otto Sonofadeadme cleaned grit from the rifle bolt with a scrap of cloth. The scrap was once the clean part of a shirt.

Otto Sonofadeadme fired at the muzzle flash across the wire before it faded. Quentin "Ash" Provadabro was grazed, and that rifle did not fire again tonight. The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Otto Sonofadeadme did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
thanos_pope: "You're late," said the corporal when Silas Pope arrived on Day 7. "Everyone's late. Get a spade." The sappers took Silas Pope in on a busy morning in S-S12. By noon he had learned the first rule of the job, and by evening the second.

Silas Pope bought a small phrasebook from a passing soldier. The first useful sentence appears after six pages about hiring a carriage. A letter from home found Silas Pope before the night shift. Silas Pope folded it small and kept it close.

A pump handle snapped off in Silas Pope's hands. He fixed it while the water rose around his ankles. A letter from home found Silas Pope before the night shift. Silas Pope folded it small and kept it close.

Night raid. Silas Pope crossed no man's land, saw the enemy sentry too late to reach, and came back without a scratch. Next time, says Silas Pope. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Silas Pope watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools. A letter from home found Silas Pope before the night shift. Silas Pope folded it small and kept it close.
whereewegoing: At the depot, Felix Whereewegoin had practised answering to his name. At Q-S12, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.
The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into Q-S12. Felix Whereewegoin has learned to walk bent double.
